text:
maria: quick sync — i put together 3 options for the next sprint re: model routing (parity vs differentiator). need a decision by EOD Thu so eng can scope. TL;DR: A) parity-shim, B) product-facing differentiator, C) minimal parity + experiment.

ajay: can you paste the short tradeoffs?

maria: Option A — tenant-level routing flags to match competitor parity. low UX delta, medium infra work, ~3 sprints. Option B — per-route cost/latency controls + one-click model switch (bigger UX & infra, ~4-5 sprints) with clear upsell. Option C — ship minimal parity shim now, incubate differentiator as an experiment.

sasha: for option B we need a clear UX surface. we should not show raw model names — surface tiers like "economy / balanced / premium". need empty-state and error flows.

jordan: sales signal: ACME wants parity now & is sensitive to cross-region latency — if we match them they’ll sign. mid-market merchants care about cost controls (option B).

ben: quick lab numbers: parity shim (quantized variant) => p95 latency +7%, unit cost +12% vs baseline. model-switch prototype (option B) reduced token usage in our trace set by ~18%.

priya: ops note — option B implies per-route autoscale and more complex capacity planning. rough cost delta +$12k/mo on current fleet. need SRE signoff for runway.

ajay: can we do a 3-day spike to validate model-switch KV cache behavior and routing failovers? if spike passes, we could combine A+B (shim now + incremental UI).

maria: proposed launch criteria (must-haves): 1) parity shim deployed and enabled for top-10 customers; 2) per-route fallback policy + telemetry; 3) UX for labeled tiers and switch control; 4) perf regression <=5% p95 vs baseline. rollout plan: canary 5% tenants -> 25% -> full, with automatic rollback on error-rate spikes.

ajay: sgtm. suggest adding rollout config snippet for ops:

```yaml
rollout_policy:
  canary_percent: 5
  watch_metrics: [p95_latency, error_rate, cost_per_1k_tokens]
  rollback_condition:
    - error_rate > 0.5% for 10m
    - p95_latency increase > 10% for 5m
```

maria: adding monitoring + alerts. also include gating: legal review on telemetry for private tenants.

jordan: i'll push ACME urgency details + contract ask today. pinging account team.

maria: i'll draft the PRD and include tradeoff matrix + acceptance tests. @jordan please add the ACME note to the PRD. thanks :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: schedule created: "model-routing-experiment" -> 2026-04-02T16:00Z (prod namespace)

jordan: shared ACME doc: https://company.atlassian.net/browse/ACME-123

maria: noted. will update PRD by EOD Thu and loop in SRE + legal.
